comments.body: You can definitely make it with that budget, I had the same during studies and knew others with it too. But you have to be quick to find a job, you can just do any kind of job, it doesn’t have to be connected to what your studying, could also just be a student job. And also you won’t really be able to afford going out with friends a lot. And you must make sure to pay very little rent.
comments.author: sweet_selection_1996
